name: Advanced Process Systems Corporation
summary: Advanced Process Systems Corporation (APS) specializes in developing and distributing sophisticated machinery essential for semiconductor and display manufacturing. Its primary operational regions include South Korea, China, and Vietnam. The company's extensive product portfolio features various advanced equipment, such as excimer laser annealing, laser lift-off, and precision fine metal micro-machining systems. APS also provides in-line glass laser scribing and film laser cutting apparatus, rapid thermal processing units, one-drop filling and encapsulation solutions, and temporary bond and de-bond process systems. Further offerings encompass thin-film encapsulation and sputtering systems, alongside dry strip and descum technologies. Established in 1994, the firm maintains its main office in Hwaseong-si, South Korea. The company previously operated as Kornic Systems Corporation until its rebranding to Advanced Process Systems Corporation in 2009.
